{"candidate_rtl":"module mul_subexpression(
    input [7:0] multiplicand,
    input [7:0] multiplier,
    output [15:0] product
);

wire [15:0] partial0;
wire [15:0] partial1;
wire [15:0] partial2;
wire [15:0] partial3;
wire [15:0] partial4;
wire [15:0] partial5;
wire [15:0] partial6;
wire [15:0] partial7;

assign partial0 = {8'b0, (multiplicand & {8{multiplier[0]}})} << 0;
assign partial1 = {8'b0, (multiplicand & {8{multiplier[1]}})} << 1;
assign partial2 = {8'b0, (multiplicand & {8{multiplier[2]}})} << 2;
assign partial3 = {8'b0, (multiplicand & {8{multiplier[3]}})} << 3;
assign partial4 = {8'b0, (multiplicand & {8{multiplier[4]}})} << 4;
assign partial5 = {8'b0, (multiplicand & {8{multiplier[5]}})} << 5;
assign partial6 = {8'b0, (multiplicand & {8{multiplier[6]}})} << 6;
assign partial7 = {8'b0, (multiplicand & {8{multiplier[7]}})} << 7;

wire [15:0] sum01;
wire [15:0] sum23;
wire [15:0] sum45;
wire [15:0] sum67;
wire [15:0] sum0123;
wire [15:0] sum4567;

assign sum01 = partial0 + partial1;
assign sum23 = partial2 + partial3;
assign sum45 = partial4 + partial5;
assign sum67 = partial6 + partial7;
assign sum0123 = sum01 + sum23;
assign sum4567 = sum45 + sum67;
assign product = sum0123 + sum4567;

endmodule","bottleneck":"The original implementation serializes seven 16-bit accumulations, creating a long carry-propagation chain. The rewrite uses a balanced three-level addition tree, reducing arithmetic depth from seven adder levels to three while retaining explicit 16-bit truncation at every intermediate sum.","rewrite":"Represent each multiplier-selected multiplicand as an explicitly zero-extended and shifted 16-bit partial product, then combine the eight partial products pairwise, combine those results pairwise, and perform one final addition. This preserves unsigned behavior and modulo-2^16 intermediate semantics while exposing balanced parallel structure to synthesis.","expected_timing_gain":"Substantial reduction in maximum data arrival time is expected because the critical arithmetic depth is reduced from seven serial additions to three balanced additions. The exact gain depends on SKY130HD mapping and buffering, but the critical path should be materially shorter than the 2.45 ns baseline.","area_or_other_cost":"The number of 16-bit additions is unchanged, so mapped area should remain near the baseline, with some possible overhead from less width-specialized optimization. The estimated area remains within the stated cap, and the balanced structure should not introduce storage, latches, or additional interface logic.","functional_boundaries":"The module name, ports, widths, unsigned signedness, output truncation, and combinational behavior are preserved. All eight partial products are generated for arbitrary input bits, and the balanced additions are 16-bit operations; modulo-2^16 associativity ensures the final product matches the original unsigned multiplication for every 8-bit input combination."}
